key.name: poll-interval-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, the extension asks the AgentOS session broker for a status snapshot. Lower values feel more responsive; higher values cost fewer wake-ups. Allowed range is 2 to 60 seconds.

key.name: show-task-count-in-panel
key.summary: Show the active task count in the top bar
key.description: When enabled, the top-bar indicator shows the number of queued, running and approval-waiting tasks next to the icon. When disabled the indicator stays icon-only.

key.name: notify-on-task-failure
key.description: When enabled, the extension raises one desktop notification per failed task signature. Notifications are always rate limited to one per 30 seconds and never repeat the same signature within 5 minutes.

key.name: notify-on-approval
key.summary: Notify when a task is waiting for approval
key.description: When enabled, the extension raises one desktop notification per pending approval signature. The extension only announces approvals; the AgentOS desktop application is the only place where an approval can be decided.

key.name: max-recent-events
key.summary: Recent events shown in the menu
key.description: Maximum number of recent activity entries listed in the menu. The broker never sends more than 10 events, so the allowed range is 1 to 10.
